steps.en: Owner sees which of their notices can be furnished
steps.id: Owner melihat NOPO mana yang bisa di-furnish
steps.why_en: Demo note says offender details could not be fetched from the encrypted internet database; not provable here.
steps.why_id: Catatan demo bilang data offender gagal diambil dari database internet terenkripsi; tidak bisa dibuktikan dari repo.

steps.en: Only notices at set stages such as 1st or 2nd reminder can be furnished
steps.id: Hanya NOPO di stage tertentu seperti reminder ke-1 atau ke-2 yang bisa di-furnish

steps.en: Owner enters the hirer or driver details and the form checks them
steps.id: Owner mengisi data hirer atau driver dan form memeriksanya

steps.en: Submitted details are saved as a pending application
steps.id: Data yang dikirim disimpan sebagai pengajuan berstatus pending

steps.en: System auto-approves clean submissions and sends the rest to manual review
steps.id: Sistem menyetujui otomatis pengajuan yang lolos, sisanya ke review manual

steps.en: Approved hirer or driver becomes the offender with the given mailing address
steps.id: Hirer atau driver yang disetujui jadi offender dengan alamat surat yang diberikan

steps.en: Notice moves to the hirer or driver letter stage so follow-up targets them
steps.id: NOPO pindah ke stage surat hirer atau driver supaya tindak lanjut mengarah ke mereka

steps.en: Automated reminder workflow then runs per Appendix B
steps.id: Alur reminder otomatis lalu jalan sesuai Appendix B
steps.why_en: Appendix B is not in the code, and sending letters to the printer is blocked by configuration.
steps.why_id: Appendix B tidak ada di code, dan pengiriman surat ke vendor cetak diblok konfigurasi.
